Chief Secy. ... on 11 April, 2025 Author: Karunesh Singh Pawar Bench: Karunesh Singh Pawar High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench ?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc-Lko:20776 Court No. - 18 Case :- Writ - A No. - 3333 of 2025 Petitioner :- Ramesh Lal Gupta Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Addl. Chief Secy. Food Safety And Drug Administration Counsel for Petitioner :- Brijesh Kumar Singh,Raghvendra Singh
texts.facts: His representation/appeal against the punishment order dated 20.10.2015 has not been decided by the Chief Secretary, State of U.P., who is the appellate authority of the petitioner. He gave reply vide his letter dated 21.2.2016, upon which the Commissioner, Food Safety and Drug Administration, U.P. was directed to provide instructions. As per instructions, it was provided that the petitioner has not provided any certificate that he was not employed elsewhere during the period of his suspension and was not in any business which is essential for payment of subsistence allowance, that is why, the subsistence allowance has not been given to the petitioner. It is submitted that a decision has been taken under Fundamental Rule 53 of Financial Hand Book, Khand 2, Part 2 to 4. As regards the appeal filed by the petitioner dated 8.11.2015, it is submitted that against the order dated 20.10.2015, no appeal/representation has been received as per records in the U.P. Government.
texts.arguments: 4.Ms. Deepshikha, learned Chief Standing Counsel on the basis of written instructions has submitted that the petitioner was given a show cause notice along with copy of the punishment order dated 9.11.2015 in view of the provisions of Fundamental Rule 54 of Financial Hand Book Khand 2 Part 2 regarding arrears of salary as well as subsistence allowance during his suspension period as well as for counting the period of suspension for being treated as spent on duty, and the petitioner was required to give reply within two months. However, the petitioner has not given any reply within the aforesaid period.
texts.respondent_arguments: 4.Ms. Deepshikha, learned Chief Standing Counsel on the basis of written instructions has submitted that the petitioner was given a show cause notice along with copy of the punishment order dated 9.11.2015 in view of the provisions of Fundamental Rule 54 of Financial Hand Book Khand 2 Part 2 regarding arrears of salary as well as subsistence allowance during his suspension period as well as for counting the period of suspension for being treated as spent on duty, and the petitioner was required to give reply within two months. However, the petitioner has not given any reply within the aforesaid period.
